raw_segments.text: Antony, to him again. Tell him he wears the rows of youth upon him, from which the world
should note something particular. His coin, ships, legions may be a coward's, whose ministers
would prevail under the service of a child as soon as I.T.H., command of Caesar. I dare
him therefore to lay his gay comparisons apart, and answer me declined, sword against sword,
ourselves alone. I'll write it. Follow me.
